description: Free: add your own paid endpoint to the x402 Trust Index when no registry lists it yet (CDP Bazaar, Circle's Agent Marketplace, GoPlausible, MPP directory). x402 Doctor first checks that it answers 402 with a payment challenge (x402, MPP or L402); the next daily scan starts its record, which buyers' agents see before they pay. At most 25 endpoints per host. Limited to 10 calls per hour.

url.description: The x402 endpoint (public http(s) URL), e.g. https://api.example.com/paid

name: x402_trust_add

check.description: The free web check for this URL

ok.description: true: added, already added, or already listed

status.description: added, submitted (already added) or listed (a registry lists it)

verdict.description: The pre-payment verdict when it was added

title: Add your endpoint to the x402 Trust Index (free)
